title: Dukhtare shabbir hai
body:
haye sakina haye haye sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
dukhtare shabbir hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dard ki tasveer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay sajjad ro kar kaise behlaun mai khwahar
ye tera majboor bhai kya sunaye tujhko aa kar
paon mein zanjeer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak hi bistar hai tera khaak hi takiya hai tera
raaigan ay meri khwahar har ghadi rona hai tera
ab yehi taqdeer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kahan se laaun beta zakhm ka marham bata de
tujhko khaane hai yahan par ghurkiyan aur taaziyane
ek tu dilgeer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashke gham peeti raho ab gham pe gham sehti raho
jis tarha bhi ho mayassar qaid mein jeeti raho
ab yehi tauqeer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap ki furqat mein jeena hai bada mushkil magar
jo muqaddar mein likha hai sabr kar le sabr kar
dard ki tehreer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh tere gham mein roti hai phupi zainab teri
khatm ho jaaye na rote rote unki zindagi
waarise tatheer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek sukoon ka saans lena bhi yahan mumkin nahi
jeete jee teri rehaai meri jaan mumkin nahi
waqt ki zanjeer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid mein sajjad kehte thay ye mazhar abidi
kis tarha taqdeer bigdi mustafa ke aal ki
qalb mein ye teer hai aur qaid khana shaam ka
dukhtare shabbir hai aur...
author: Mazhar Abidi
